about: this level's own constants for the picture tools (tools/haifa, docs/level/PICTURE_LEVEL_RECIPE.md). Cells are x, y bottom-up; px boxes are x0, y0, x1, y1 in a panel's picture, keyed by the panel's number from 1. The level itself (its cells, sandbags, ladder holes, the loads that take their painted outline) comes from src/content/haifa/harbour_layout.json through the model: nothing here names a place of it.

fineArt.made: tools/haifa/fine_art.py (16.11): the longer harbour's panels as pixel matter for the destruction engine
fineArt.insideWhy: 17.11 R3: whole = the silo east wall (pale plaster the colour test frayed into holes); inside = the freighter hull (450..496) and the silo works (386..421): a blast there opens onto the dark inside, never sea or sky; holes = where px enclosed in one solid cell become matter (never in the owner-approved cells 0..104)

sky.solidWhy: pale things at the haze line the matte took for sky: panel 1 a stone of the customs house west wall; panel 4 fuel tank 1 and the rim of tank 2; panel 5 tank 2 again and the panes of the fort window on floor 1; panel 6 the silo works inside its walls and its elevator head (pale plaster), panel 7 the freighter's superstructure (17.11, the R2 layout)
